# mycel — Multi-Agent Orchestration Platform

> mycel is a CLI-first, agent-agnostic orchestration platform for AI coding agents. It coordinates teams of AI agents across isolated git worktrees with persistent memory, structured communication channels, and per-agent cost controls.

## Key Features

- **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Run 5-10 AI coding agents in parallel, each in its own isolated git worktree plus a tmux or Docker sandbox
- **Channel Communication**: Structured channels for agent-to-agent coordination, plus a notifications hub that bridges Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp (agents can reply from your phone)
- **Insights Dashboard**: Real-time cost and token observability — live spend, burn rate, active agents, and top cost driver, broken down per agent and per model, read straight from the cost ledger
- **Cost Controls**: Per-agent token tracking, budgets, alerts, and automatic hard stops
- **Encrypted Secrets**: Per-agent secrets encrypted at rest, injected as MYCEL_ environment variables at spawn
- **Scheduled Tasks**: Cron-powered automation for tests, deploys, and reports
- **Web Dashboard**: Real-time monitoring of agents, channels, costs, secrets, and providers at localhost:9374

## Supported AI Tools

mycel ships built-in providers for:
- Claude Code
- Gemini
- Codex
- Cursor
- Aider

## Quick Start

```bash
mycel init --preset small-team
mycel up
mycel home
```
